hooks.name: walkthrough-before-demo-claim
hooks.description: After the haunted demo or the walkthrough script changes, remind the agent to run the transcript and the web demo checks before claiming the demo works.

action.prompt: Do not claim the haunted demo works until python3 scripts/demo_walkthrough.py exits 0 and python3 -m pytest tests/test_web_demo.py passes. The transcript must show question, answer, quote span, and pass/fail for both eob-explainer and lease-checker. The page must pick a fixture or paste a synthetic document, call DocumentAgent, and show cited claims versus ghost claims. Empty and oversized input must return HTTP 400. Also run python3 evals/run_evals.py and python3 -m pytest. Follow .kiro/steering/haunted-demo.md. The demo is synthetic, not a medical device, and not legal advice. Do not add a deployment or credentials.
